messages:
sam: FYI - I can repro a console leak: quick-switching orgs occasionally renders another org's insight widget rows for ~2s before the client corrects. Steps: 1) open /console/insights, 2) click topbar org switch, 3) notice ghost rows in widget.
sam: captured network: GET /api/internal/insights/widgets/prefetch?limit=15
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer xxx
  X-Org-Id: 42
  X-Route: console-widget-prefetch
Response 200 payload contains orgId: 7 (mismatch).
anya: ouch. that looks like cache namespace collision. we moved to tag-based cache keys in the edge to reduce cardinality last week. if tags no longer include org id, you'll see cross-tenant hits.
mark: that was the change in PR #489 - simplified cache tags to "route:console" + path fragment so CDN hit rate improved. didn't think about org-scoped widgets.
infra-bot: deploy: edge-proxy/canary-2026-03-21 at 2026-03-21T09:12:00 rolled to 12% hosts.
sam: timeline matches - started after that canary.
anya: short-term mitigation: restrict the simplified tag for public static assets only. for any endpoints under /api/internal/insights or /api/console we should include tenant context in the cache key.
mark: agreed. quick patch: include X-Org-Id in cacheKey for endpoints that return org-scoped resources and add Vary: X-Org-Id header on responses. I'll draft PR.
sre-oncall: also add a telemetry counter for cache.tenant_mismatch and an alert if >3/min. we need to know exposure magnitude.
mark: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference/edge-proxy/pull/503 - adds tenant-aware keys for insights and widgets + unit tests for cache key generation.
deploy-bot: job queued: edge-proxy/patch-503 -> canary 2%
anya: deploy plan: canary 2% -> monitor mismatch metric -> 20% -> 100%. If mismatch spikes after 2% rollback immediately.
sam: can we do a one-off scrub of telemetry and billing for the 09:109:25 window? want to ensure usage metrics weren't aggregated cross-org.
sre-oncall: scheduled a scrub job on billing/usage for 2026-03-21T09:10:00 to 2026-03-21T09:25:00 and will report anomalies.
mark: follow-ups: (1) automated e2e that simulates rapid org-switch and asserts no cross-tenant payloads, (2) add documentation for cache-tagging policy and per-endpoint whitelist, (3) migration plan to introduce per-tenant cache namespaces for sensitive endpoints.
anya: also add a QuickSight tile: "Dashboard Cache Tenant Leakage" (tile id: dash-911) and set alert at 3 mismatches/min, paging to SRE.
sam: I'll file a short customer-facing note in incidents if we see any user reports.
mark: merging PR once tests pass; canary will start in ~10min. target rollback window if alert fires.
infra-bot: metric: edge-proxy.cache_hit_rate increased by 6% after 489; observing new cache.tenant_mismatch traces at 09:14 UTC.
sam: thanks all. ping me if you need the repro account or screenshots.
